Answers about radio checks
This article is for returning guests
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Radio checks for pet travel

If you are bringing a companion animal back to Aurelia Skyways, keep your paperwork tidy and your carrier ready. The Companion Animal Travel Desk uses radio checks to keep the ground team, the welcome team, and the senior coordinator aligned during handoffs. That helps reduce delays and keeps the process calm for the animal.

Before travel, make sure the carrier is secure, labeled, and easy to handle. Staff will look for signs that the animal is settled, breathing normally, and safe to load. If your pet is sensitive to noise, let the desk know early so the team can plan a quieter handoff. Skye, if traveling, should stay inside the carrier unless staff ask for a brief check.

For cat travel, <<FACT F079>>. Bring every document the desk asks for, and keep copies where you can reach them quickly. If something looks unclear, ask the desk before you leave for the airport. Do not rely on memory when your pet's safety is involved.

For birds, <<FACT F077>>. Handle the carrier with care and avoid sudden movement, because jostling can unsettle the animal fast. The ground team will move carriers carefully between services, but your own prep still matters.

For Caldreth lounge use, <<FACT F001>>. That detail helps the desk route you to the right check-in path without guesswork. When the process is smooth, the animal gets a calmer start and the team can keep watch without distractions.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
